title: Article 7 of the Member Credit Register: Holdings in the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
**7.1** A member may carry at most 2 crop input accounts at once, counting every account that is not closed, because the cooperative underwrites the member rather than the account and two sets of books is as far as the credit department will follow one operation.

**7.2** The ordinary pairing is one charge or financing account for the season's buying and one prepay account for money paid in ahead, and a second charge account is not opened while a first one is live; a member who wants different terms has the existing account rewritten instead.

**7.3** A programme of Crop Input Purchasing Accounts whose entry gate calls for a credit review is not opened until the credit department has recorded its decision on that member.

**7.4** A programme whose entry gate calls for a security interest is not opened until the perfected security interest covering the growing crop is recorded on file. Neither of those is taken from the member's account of what their lender has filed, however confident they sound.

**7.5** Where either is outstanding the application is taken and the account waits in applied or under credit review; the member buys for cash in the meantime.

## Basis of the authority

The two conditions in 7.3 and 7.4 are conditions on the opening of the account, tested before it is opened. Both are read from the cooperative's own record of the member's crop input account — the programme it is held under, the account's own reference number, and whether a perfected security interest stands recorded against it. What the member reports of their lender's filing is not that record.

## Points of judgement

| The record shows | The application is |
| --- | --- |
| One live charge account and no prepay account | Open to a prepay account, the pairing in 7.2 |
| One live charge account and a request for a second charge account | Not opened while the first is live; the existing account is rewritten |
| Two accounts not closed | At the holding of 2 already |
| A programme calling for a review, no recorded decision | Taken, and the account waits in applied or under credit review |
| A programme calling for a security interest, none recorded on file | Taken, and the account waits in applied or under credit review |

Where an application waits, nothing stops the member buying for cash meanwhile.
